claim: GRAMMAR 1 teaches a second use of て-form + います, an action intentionally repeated over a period (KS2), and no card back explains it.
evidence: Book, GRAMMAR 1: "The て-form います can also be used to express an action intentionally repeated over a certain period of time. (KS2)" KS2: "スミスさんは にほんごを ならっています。" Cards naratte-imasu-taking-lessons and ks-smith-learning-japanese have no note; the only ています explanation in either unit is tsukutte-imasu-be-making: "for an action happening right now." The IV answers (kato-guitar-weekly etc.) and jogging-o-shimasu-1 show the sense without saying it.
fix: Add a note to naratte-imasu-taking-lessons (or ks-smith-learning-japanese) saying ています also describes something done regularly over a period, such as taking lessons every week, not only what is happening right now.

claim: NOTES 1 explains when できました／おわりました take が (news to the listener) and when は (topic already raised), and that もう can come first or later; both shapes ship but no back explains the difference.
evidence: Book, NOTES: "When the information about what is done or finished ... is new to the listener, the pattern ... noun が できました ／ おわりました is used. In the first sentence, Kato has already taken up the topic かいぎの じゅんび, so the particle が is replaced with は. The もう can be placed at the beginning or later in the sentence." Cards: dialogue-materials-ready "しりょうができました" (no note); meeting-materials-ready-q "かいぎのしりょうはもうできましたか" (no note); dekimashita note only says "It says something is finished and ready: しりょうが できました".
fix: Extend the dekimashita note: use が when announcing that something is done, は when the thing is already the topic (as in a もう question), and もう may go at the start or after the topic.

claim: The target dialogue line combining the chapter’s contrast は and ています, かいぎしつは よやくしましたが、しりょうは いま つくっています, has no card.
evidence: Book, TARGET DIALOGUE: "かいぎしつは よやくしましたが、 しりょうは いま つくっています。" / "I reserved the meeting room, but I am now preparing the materials." No card in chapter-23 or chapter-23-extras carries it or a variant; the other dialogue lines are carded or have close variants.
fix: Add an extras card for the line with the book’s English.

claim: Five Speaking Practice lines have no card, among them the chapter’s phone call-back line and a ています line.
evidence: Book, SPEAKING PRACTICE: "いつ できますか。" (When will it be ready?), "いま りょうりを しています。" (I’m cooking now), "じゃ、また あとで でんわします。" (I’ll call you back later), "しごとの あとですか。" (You do that after work?), "いいえ、あさ はしっています。" (I go running in the morning). None of these is a card; the answers around them (dialogue-dry-cleaning-ready-wednesday-evening, ima-ii-desu-ka, dialogue-doing-any-exercise) are.
fix: Add extras cards for at least いつ できますか, いま りょうりを しています and じゃ、また あとで でんわします, with the book’s English and a scene where the English alone is ambiguous.

claim: The note says only 3 voices the floor counter to がい, but the book prints さんがい／さんかい and なんがい／なんかい.
evidence: Card note: "Only 3 voices it to がい; the other numbers keep かい." Book, Appendix H: "Floors of a house or building: 〜かい / がい ... さんがい 3rd floor さんかい 〃 ... なんがい ／ なんかい how many floors, which floor".
fix: Reword: 3 is usually さんがい (さんかい is also heard), and なんがい asks which floor; 1, 6, 8 and 10 change their sound (いっかい, ろっかい, はちかい, じゅっかい).

claim: The card is excluded because はじめます is said to be untaught, but はじめます is a Lesson 17 card, so the exclusion reason is false.
evidence: excludedReason: "はじめます (begin) is not taught in this book yet; only はじめまして is". Ledger before Lesson 23, chapter-17: "はじめます | Start, begin" and "はじめる | Start, begin (dictionary form)". The card’s romaji is also garbled: "mōsu gukaigiohajimemasu."
fix: Either restore the card with corrected romaji (mōsugu kaigi o hajimemasu) or re-exclude it with a true reason (もうすぐ already has three extras sentences).
